# Frozen WebGPU reference header

The header and license here retain their original bytes and paths for sealed
independent migration tests, source-input manifests, the frozen future-owner
characterization and historical receipts. They are not the live include owner.

Current C, package, benchmark and Zig builds consume the byte-identical pinned
header at [`runtime/vendor/webgpu-headers`](../../../vendor/webgpu-headers/).
Its pin is declared by [`config/webgpu-abi-source.json`](../../../../config/webgpu-abi-source.json).
Preserve this reference copy until its independent consumers are deliberately
retired under their own acceptance contracts.
